verdict.rationale: Unit is built for programmatic use. Its docs describe building on the platform via APIs, a documented JSON:API REST API with an official OpenAPI 3.0 spec and Postman collection, a full-replica sandbox with simulation endpoints, and a published six-month deprecation notice policy. The probe 404s on well-known OpenAPI paths do not contradict this, because the spec is documented as hosted in the official SDK repository. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of API use, explicit API versioning scheme (paths are unversioned).

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can drive the product through a documented public API

citations.quote: Companies can build directly on the Unit Platform using APIs and components, with control over their product experience and operating model.
An OpenAPI 3.0 specification for the Unit API is available here
Unit's Sandbox environment is a full replica of the production environment — all standard API endpoints work exactly the same way.
The Unit Dashboard and APIs provide teams with access to customer, account, payment, card, transaction, compliance, and operational data.
